ar.title: الشعرية

steps.n1: يقدح السمن أو الزيت وتحمر فيه الشعرية حتى يصير لونها ذهبيا.
steps.n2: يضرب في الخلاط البصل والطماطم، وممكن استبدال الطماطم بالصلصة.
steps.n3: نحضر إناء آخر ونضع فيه المرق وخليط البصل والطماطم ونتبلهم بالملح والفلفل حتى الغليان.
steps.n4: يسكب المرق بالصلصة على الشعرية ويقلبوا جيدا، ثم تهدأ الحرارة وبعد أن تتشرب الشعرية السائل تخفض الحرارة حتى النضج.
steps.n5: ممكن استبدال المرق بالماء مع زيادة كمية السمن أو الزيت إلى الضعف.

en.title: Toasted Vermicelli in Tomato Broth

steps.n1: Heat the ghee or oil and sauté the vermicelli until it turns golden brown.
steps.n2: Blend the onion and tomatoes in a blender; tomato paste can be used as a substitute for fresh tomatoes.
steps.n3: In another pot, combine the broth and the onion-tomato mixture, then season with salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
steps.n4: Pour the broth and tomato mixture over the vermicelli and stir well, then reduce the heat; once the vermicelli has absorbed the liquid, lower the heat further until cooked through.
steps.n5: The broth can be replaced with water, provided the amount of ghee or oil is doubled.

legacySteps: Heat the ghee or oil and sauté the vermicelli until it turns golden brown.
Blend the onion and tomatoes in a blender; tomato paste can be used as a substitute for fresh tomatoes.
In another pot, combine the broth and the onion-tomato mixture, then season with salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
Pour the broth and tomato mixture over the vermicelli and stir well, then reduce the heat; once the vermicelli has absorbed the liquid, lower the heat further until cooked through.
The broth can be replaced with water, provided the amount of ghee or oil is doubled.
